author: GamingBolt
description:
While I wouldn't relegate it to the bottom of the barrel of indies this year, Forever Ago still feels mostly competent instead of outright special. A solid addition to this kind of narrative rather than one that competes with the best. 

If the gameplay were slightly more involved, and the pacing didn't drag with some of the less exciting walking segments, it could have been more. As such, it's an acceptable effort that's successful enough with the drama, but not much more.
title: Forever Ago Review - Is This Single Player Road Trip Adventure Worth the Ride?

author: GamingBolt
description:
Dragon’s Dogma 2: Dark Arisen isn’t an expansion that lets you relax at any point during your time in Norgan’s sprawling map. It’s also one that gets very addictive once you fall into the pattern of exploring and upgrading it intends for you. But getting that initial bit of momentum can seem like a very daunting ask in the face of enemies that decimate you without breaking a sweat.

Well, we’re here to help ease the transition from the base game into Norgan, with tips and tricks that are going to help you find your footing faster than you might have on your own. Join us if you’re thinking about venturing to the frozen lands, and to take on the Undead Dragon as soon as you can.
title: Dragon’s Dogma 2: Dark Arisen - 15 Things You Wish You Knew Before Playing

author: GamingBolt
description:
Phantom Blade Zero has been on our minds ever since we first got wind of it. It’s stayed there over the course of this year, and the time to find out if it’s got what it takes to take the fight to some truly great titles released this year is now almost upon us. But can it rise above a crowded schedule of releases that could take away some of the attention it needs to show its work?

We think there’s a possibility, and that this is a game that doesn’t just need to prove itself, but do so in a way that keeps the spotlight firmly trained on it at a time when the stage is full of great actors. We’re looking at what it’s facing down in this one before we comment on what it’s got going for it. If this one’s on your radar, we’re pretty sure this one’s going to appeal to you.
title: Can Phantom Blade Zero Become A Breakout Hit In 2026’s Crowded Final Stretch?
